full_judgment:
3. The respondent herein as the plaintiff instituted Title Suit No. 263 of 2003 in the Fifth Court of Joint District Judge, Dhaka against the leave-petitioners for declaration of his 16 annas title in the suit land and that the same has wrongly been enlisted in V.P. Case No. 17 of 1977 and for further declaration that the order dated 08.07.1997 passed in Miscellaneous Case No. 5/1997-98 rejecting the mutation of the plaintiff is illegal, inoperative and not binding upon him and that the mutation of the plaintiff, allowed in Mutation Case No. 5457/1996-97 is valid and lawful. 

 III. Because having regard to the evidence of D.Ws. and exhibit-'Ka' series, rent receipts showing that the suit property was leased out through V.P. Case No. 17 of 1977 in favour of Azad Welfare Trust and the Trust has been in possession of the suit property on payment of rent to Government as found rightly by the trial Court and the appellate Court on misreading and non-reading of the evidence and misconstruction of the exhibited documents was manifestly wrong in holding that the plaintiff is in possession of the suit property and thus the plaintiff having failed to prove possession in the suit property, the suit itself is not maintainable in view of provision of section 42 of the Specific Relief Act non-consideration of the same by the appellate Court has occasioned failure of justice.
